## Quality checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes locally or in CI
- [ ] `npm run build` passes locally or in CI
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, tokens, passwords, or private customer data committed
- [ ] User-facing errors are safe and do not expose stack traces
- [ ] Audit events were added for relevant business/security actions
- [ ] Debug logs use correlation IDs and mask sensitive data
- [ ] Authorization/RBAC impact was reviewed
- [ ] Documentation was updated when behavior changed

## Security review

- [ ] No new unauthenticated admin path
- [ ] No direct exposure of uploaded files, templates, exports, or runtime state
- [ ] Input validation exists for new/changed endpoints
- [ ] File upload behavior was reviewed, if applicable
- [ ] AI prompt/document handling was reviewed for prompt-injection risk, if applicable
